sources.name: daily OHLCV bars (same as v3: /workspace/updown/bars_all.parquet 2018-01-02..2026-10-06 + free yfinance top-ups to 2026-10-19)
sources.note: All stock-level blocks (TA, divergence, green/red) use bars dated N-1 and earlier. Universe: price >= $5, top 500 by 20-day dollar volume as of N-1.

sources.name: CBOE index history CSVs: VIX (1990-), VIX9D (2011-), VIX3M (2009-), SKEW (1990-), VVIX (2006-) from cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/<IDX>_History.csv
sources.note: Market-level options-implied data (IV level, term structure, tail skew, vol-of-vol). Row dated D is final by ~16:15 ET on D; joined to prediction day N = next session.

sources.name: CBOE equity put/call ratio CSV (cdn.cboe.com/resources/options/volume_and_call_put_ratios/equitypc.csv)
sources.note: Public file stops at 2019-10-04, so it cannot cover the 2020-2026 walk-forward. Excluded.

sources.name: DoltHub post-no-preference/options (per-ticker IV/HV, chains, 2019-02..)
sources.note: Free per-ticker IV history ~2,300 symbols but only from 2019, capture time per row undocumented (leak risk), bulk pull needs the dolt CLI and many GB. Not ingested in v4; candidate for v4b.
